correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the 12-vertex line graph and all 164 disconnected-triple facets. All 3954 faces and 23208 Hasse edges are enumerated, the 1968-pair acyclic matching is checked by complete DAG topological sorting, and the 6x11 integral signed Morse boundary has rank 5 and an explicit unit 5x5 minor. Its rank/unit factors yield \(H_7\cong\mathbb Z\) and \(H_8\cong\mathbb Z^6\); attaching maps of dimension eight to wedges of dimension-seven spheres are degree vectors, so elementary integral changes of basis give \(S^7\vee\bigvee^6 S^8\). An independent complete F2 simplicial rank computation agrees; mod-2 ranks alone were not mistaken for an integral proof. Pure dimension eight with lower homology implies non-shellability.

value.rationale: The cuboctahedral graph is a canonical 12-vertex Archimedean and line-graph object. The exact mixed-dimensional homotopy classification is meaningful because general Theorem 6.1 is inapplicable (six missing seven-dimensional faces), yet the result proves torsion-free integral homology. The nonzero \(H_7\) certifies genuine non-shellability of the pure eight-dimensional complex, and neither its face count/Euler characteristic nor the known cube cut complex yields the (1,6) Betti classification or homotopy type. This is a natural exact finite invariant with structural boundary significance, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
